hypothesis: The revalidated right-foot swing has too little lateral task-space reach and grazes the ball, causing a large sideways impulse; 0.10 m bounded reach may center contact better than 0.05 m.
shared_setup: One G1 and one ball per independent process; same frozen late-swing gate, swing-side revalidation enabled, no support-knee action, same parent asset and SONIC.
measure: From ball trajectory, calculate 60-frame post-first-contact forward displacement dx, absolute lateral displacement |dy|, and |dy|/max(dx,0.01). Require frame-level action and contact audit.
diagnostic_gate: Both courses remain foot-only and safe, with ratio reduced by at least 30 percent on both courses and no negative forward displacement; otherwise reject this cap change.
